name: Anwen
greeting: Nothing answered when I rang the bell.
lines: Kael: Were you hoping it would?
Anwen: I don't know. That is the honest answer today.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The copied command and the household register lie on her table. Human hands saved them before the glade burned. Their evidence has not become less true because its witness is gone.

lines: Anwen: There are things we can no longer ask. We must mark those gaps instead of filling them with convenient answers.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A father passing the table says his child slept without hearing voices. Anwen listens until he has finished.

lines: Kael: We keep what remains. And answer for what we chose.
Anwen: Tor needs another pair of hands. The next repair cannot wait for us to feel certain.
